The residence

Maëlle

A 2+1 residence of 96.6 m² at SOL Residence, set into the hillside above Vlorë with expansive glazing and layered terracing down to the bay. The building is finished and complete — the apartment is ready to occupy in about two weeks, and the incoming owner still chooses their own finishes, tiling and flooring included. An open living, dining and kitchen opens onto a balcony; two bedrooms and two bathrooms sit behind. Two hundred metres from the water, in the Kalaja quarter of the Albanian Riviera.

Location & setting

Above the bay at Kalaja, Vlorë

SOL Residence sits on the hillside at Kalaja, Vlorë, where the Ceraunian coast opens onto the Bay of Vlorë — two hundred metres from the water. A finished residential complex of expansive glazing and layered terraces, minutes from the beach, the town, and the coast road south into the Riviera.
